name: Voice Assistant
description: Speak to a model and route approved commands to PI-Desktop.

en.name: Voice Assistant
en.description: Speak to a model and route approved commands to PI-Desktop.
en.safetyNotes: Uses the system microphone through the browser SpeechRecognition API. Spoken commands are routed through PI-Desktop's host-owned desktop-operation catalog; the plugin never sends raw audio to external servers. Model keys and API credentials are never exposed to the plugin.

zh-CN.name: 语音助手
zh-CN.description: 语音对话，将语音指令路由到 PI-Desktop 已审核的桌面操作目录。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 通过浏览器 SpeechRecognition API 使用系统麦克风。语音指令经 PI-Desktop 宿主已审核的桌面操作目录路由；插件不会将原始音频发送到外部服务器。模型密钥和 API 凭据不会暴露给插件。
